notes.title: Volume 1 Redux
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41595186/0b62e65c8e8be2455b2a23217e9a16bcba582954.jpg[/img]

"Dearest readers, in preparation for the upcoming third volume brace yourselves for an exhilarating reimagining of 'Voltitan' in its riveting first volume! As the narrative unfolds, witness the meteoric rise of Leonard, no longer a mere gag rival but now the very heart of darkness as the arc's paramount villain. His ambition, cunning, and power challenge our heroes in ways never seen before. And behold, the Valkyries! No longer the shadows behind the throne, these fierce warriors emerge as the true bearers of the Godbeasts' power. Their connection with Marvin evolves, adding layers of depth and intrigue as they wield the immense strength of these ancient creatures. Their divine soles don't just enchant; they control, dictate, and dominate the course of the story. With twists at every corner and legends reborn, 'Voltitan Vol.1' promises a journey unlike any other. Dive in and let the saga of passion, power, and podo particles envelop you!
